title: सल्यान जिल्लाको सामाजिक भाषिका {salyan jillako samajik bhasika}
nepali: सल्यानी सामाजिक भाषिकाको क्षेत्रः सल्यान जिल्ला हवाइजहाजको आकृतिमा निर्मित छ । पूर्व दार्मा गा.वि.स. देखि पश्चिम संग्रही देवस्थलसम्म र उत्तर चौरजहारु िसीमादेखि दक्षिण फालावाङ्ग गा.वि.स. सम्म फैलिएको छ । यसरी हेर्दा पूर्व रोल्पा, रुकुम पश्चिम सुर्खेत दक्षिण दाङ्ग र उत्तरको रुकुम जिल्लासँगको निकटवर्ती क्षेत्रको रुपमा चिनिएको छ । यति भएर पनि यो जिल्ला स्वशासित एवम् खुला जिल्लाको सेरोफेरोमा रहेको छ । सामाजिक भाषिकाको निर्धारणः सल्यानी भाषिका पूर्वेली भाषिकाअन्तर्गत समावेश गरिन्छ । नेपाली भाषाको उत्पत्ति सिंजा वा सो क्षेत्रबाट प्रसारित हुँदै जाजरकोट, रुकुमबाट प्रसाद हुँदै सल्यानमा प्रभाव पारेको देखिन्छ । प्रायः कर्णाली प्रदेशमा बोलिने भाषाका केह िशब्द वा वाक्य सल्यान क्षेत्रमा भाषिकाको रुप देखाएको छ । कर्णाली र भेरी क्षेत्रबाट सिंचित भई नदीको किनारै–किनार यसै भाषाको बोलचाल गरिने भएकाले पनि सल्यानी भाषिकालाई खस भाषाको मूलरुप मान्न सकिन्छ । यस भाषाका भाषिकाहरू निर्धारण गर्दा क्षेत्रगत रुपमा (कुमाख क्षेत्र, खलङ्गा क्षेत्र, कोर्वाङ्ग क्षेत्र लक्ष्मीपुर क्षेत्र र फालावाङ्ग क्षेत्र) गरी ५ भागमा विभाजन गर्न सकिन्छ । यसको अन्य भाषिक अध्यनय गर्ने हो भने भाषिक क्षेत्रमा सङ्ख्या बढाउन वा घटाउन पनि सकिन्छ । सल्यानी सामाजिक भाषिकाको प्रभावित क्षेत्रः खास गरी सल्यानी सामाजिक भाषिककाको प्रभावित क्षेत्रअन्तर्गत ५४ वटै गा.वि.स.हरू पर्दछन् । किनकि एक स्थान, टोल वा समूहको भाषिकाको अन्तर दोस्रो व्यक्तिमा तत्काल असर पर्दछ । एउटा गा.वि.स.मा बोल्ने व्यक्ति महिला, पुरुष, बालक, तन्नेर,ि बुढो अर्को इलाका वा गा.वि.स.मा फरक पर्दछ । उच्च पहाडी वस्तीका बासिन्दाहरू र बेसीमा आश्रितहरूबीच भाषिक विभेद देखिन्छ । प्रायः कुमाख क्षेत्र र खलङ्गाक्षेत्र रुकुम र जाजरकोट जिल्लाको निकटतम सम्बन्ध भउकाले त्यसमा भाषिकाहरूको प्रभाव परेको देखिन्छ । व्यक्ति बोलीको निर्धारणः एउटै गा.वि.स.मा थरिथरि समुदायको सम्बन्ध र सम्पर्क हुने भएकाले साझा भाषाको काम मानक नेपाली भाषाले गर्दछ, तरपनि समाजका धनी, गरिब, उच्च, निम्न, लोग्ने मानिस, स्वास्नी मानिसहरूका भाषिक सम्पर्क र बोलचालमा फरक देखिन्छ । धनी वा सम्भ्रान्त वर्गले उच्च आदरार्थी र निम्न आदरार्धीको प्रयोग गर्दछन् भने मध्यम वा निम्नमध्यम वर्गले समान्यार्थक सम्वोधनको प्रयोग गर्दछन् । अझै निम्नस्तरको व्यक्ति वा जातिले तुच्छार्थी र अपशब्दको प्रयोग भएको पनि पाइन्छ ब्राह्मण, क्षेत्री र ठकुरीहरूले प्रायः शिष्ट वा सरल वाक्यको प्रयोग गर्दछन् । भाषिकाको व्यकरणिक संरचनाः यसअन्तर्गत शब्द निर्माण प्रकृया र स्वरुप, समास र समासका शब्दगत विविधता, सन्धि एवम् सन्धिका नियम, द्वित्वपद्धति र यससँग सम्बन्धित शब्दहरू पर्दछन् । व्याकरणिककोटीका आधारणमा वर्गीकरण गर्दै व्याकरणिक नियमअनुसार व्याकरणिक संरचनाको विश्लेषण  प्रयोग गर्ने अभ्यास गरिएको छ । उखान र टुक्काको अध्ययनः यस सामाजिक भाषिकाको अध्ययन गर्ने क्रममा जिल्लाकै उखान र टुक्काको प्रयोग गरिएको छ । यस्ता उखान र टुक्काहरू सामाजिक, गृहस्थी जीवन, धार्मिक र सामाजिक विषयवस्तुमा केन्द्रित भई उल्लेख गरिएको छ । यसमा प्रायः घरायसी सामग्री, निषेध वाणीहरू तथा प्राणीहरू पर्दछन् । नीति, ज्ञान, दर्शन र सामाजिक चेतनाको बृद्धि गर्नु यी उखानहरूको मुख्य भूमिका रहेको पाइन्छ । त्यस्तै उखानहरूको अलावा घरायसी सामग्री, शरीर र रोगसम्बन्धी नामहरू, पशुपञ्क्षी जस्ता नामिक शब्दहरूको पनि परिचय दिइएको छ ।
american_english:
Area of the Salyani social dialect
Salyan district is shaped like an aeroplane.
It extends from Darma VDC in the east to Sangrahi Devasthal in the west, and from the Chaurajaharu boundary in the north to Phalawang VDC in the south.
Seen in this way, it is known as an area adjoining Rolpa and Rukum in the east, Surkhet in the west, Dang in the south and Rukum in the north.
Even so, this district lies in the vicinity of a self-governing and open district.
Determining the social dialect: the Salyani dialect is included under the eastern dialect.
The origin of the Nepali language appears to have spread from Sinja or that area and, spreading through Jajarkot and Rukum, to have left its influence on Salyan.
For the most part, some words or sentences of the language spoken in Karnali Province have shown themselves in the form of a dialect in the Salyan area.
Because this very language, watered by the Karnali and Bheri areas, is spoken along the riverbanks, the Salyani dialect can also be considered the original form of the Khas language.
In determining the dialects of this language, it can be divided regionally into 5 parts (the Kumakh area, the Khalanga area, the Korwang area, the Laxmipur area and the Phalawang area).
If other dialect studies of it are to be done, the number of dialect areas can also be increased or decreased.
Area affected by the Salyani social dialect: in particular, all 54 VDCs fall under the area affected by the Salyani social dialect.
Because the difference in the dialect of one place, neighborhood or group has an immediate effect on the second person.
A person speaking in one VDC — woman, man, child, youth, old man — differs in another area or VDC.
A linguistic difference is seen between the inhabitants of high mountain settlements and those dependent on the besi.
Since the Kumakh area and the Khalanga area generally have the closest ties with Rukum and Jajarkot districts, the influence of the dialects appears to have fallen on them.
Determining individual speech: because communities of various sorts have relations and contact within the same VDC, standard Nepali does the work of a shared language, yet a difference is seen in the linguistic contact and speech of the rich, the poor, the high, the low, men and women of society.
The rich or affluent class uses high honorifics and low honorifics, while the middle or lower-middle class uses address forms with a neutral meaning.
People or castes of even lower standing are also found to use derogatory and abusive words; Brahmins, Kshetris and Thakuris generally use polite or simple sentences.
The grammatical structure of the dialect: this includes the process and form of word formation, compounds and the lexical variety of compounds, sandhi and the rules of sandhi, reduplication and words connected with it.
Classifying on the basis of grammatical categories, the practice of analyzing and applying the grammatical structure according to grammatical rules has been followed.
Study of proverbs and idioms: in the course of studying this social dialect, the proverbs and idioms of the district itself have been used.
Such proverbs and idioms are mentioned as centered on social, household, religious and social subject matter.
These mostly include household items, expressions of prohibition and animals.
Increasing ethics, knowledge, philosophy and social awareness is found to be the main role of these proverbs.
Besides such proverbs, an introduction is also given to nominal words such as household items, names connected with the body and with disease, and birds and beasts.

Where the Salyani social dialect is spoken

It runs from Darma VDC in the east through to Sangrahi Devasthal in the west, and from the Chaurajaharu boundary in the north down to Phalawang VDC in the south.
Looking at it that way, it comes across as an area sitting alongside Rolpa and Rukum to the east, Surkhet to the west, Dang to the south and Rukum to the north.
All the same, the district still sits in the surrounds of a self-governing and open district.
Sorting out the social dialect: the Salyani dialect is grouped under the eastern dialect.
The Nepali language looks to have started out from Sinja or that part of the country and, moving through Jajarkot and Rukum, to have made its mark on Salyan.
By and large, words or sentences from the language spoken across Karnali Province have turned up as a dialect in the Salyan area.
Because this same language, fed by the Karnali and Bheri country, is spoken all along the riverbanks, the Salyani dialect can be put down as the original form of the Khas language as well.
When you work out the dialects of this language, you can split it by region into 5 parts (the Kumakh area, the Khalanga area, the Korwang area, the Laxmipur area and the Phalawang area).
If other dialect studies of it get done, the tally of dialect areas can be pushed up or pulled back as well.
The area the Salyani social dialect reaches: in particular, all 54 VDCs come under the area the Salyani social dialect reaches.
Because a difference in the dialect of one spot, neighbourhood or group has an immediate knock-on effect on the next person.
Someone speaking in one VDC — woman, man, kid, young bloke, old fellow — comes out differently in another area or VDC.
You can see a language gap between the people of the high mountain settlements and those who depend on the besi.
Since the Kumakh area and the Khalanga area generally keep the closest ties with Rukum and Jajarkot districts, the pull of those dialects seems to have landed on them.

The rich or well-off crowd use high honorifics and low honorifics, while the middle or lower-middle crowd use forms of address with a neutral ring to them.
People or castes further down the ladder are even found using put-downs and abusive words; Brahmins, Kshetris and Thakuris mostly use polite or plain sentences.

Building up ethics, knowledge, philosophy and social awareness comes across as the main job of these proverbs.
